author: Elizabeth_A

title: We really enjoyed our tour with Fina.
text: We had a great tour of the city with Fina. Coming from a cruise ship, I had procrastinated and wasn’t able to get tickets to the Alhambra. Instead of trying to learn about Granada, I booked this tour instead. Wow - I had no idea of the Islamic history of Spain but now all of the geometric tile work I’ve seen in other places make sense. Fina was enthusiastic, easy to understand, and walked at a pace that worked for the entire group. I would highly recommend this tour.
